insight: Built by Chinese image-model startup LiblibAI; founded by an ex-ByteDance (CapCut/Jianying) commercialization lead.
name: Lovart
tagline: AI design agent — logos to full campaigns in one conversation.
description: Conversational design agent that takes a brief and produces full creative outputs — logos, posters, marketing campaigns — by orchestrating multiple image and video models on a single canvas. It iterates on the design rather than re-rolling prompts, with a credit-based freemium model.

modelSupport.notes: Orchestrates third-party image and video models on a design canvas.

edge: A conversational design agent that orchestrates many image/video models on one canvas, not a single-shot generator.
pros: End-to-end campaign output from a brief
cons: Credits drain fast on complex projects

references.title: Lovart AI Review 2025: Text-to-Visual Design Agent Tested
